summary.title: Build Web Application with Golang
summary.one_liner: An open-source book that teaches how to build web applications in Go and explains how the web works, aimed at developers coming from PHP, Python, Ruby, or C/C++.
takeaways: Learn how to build web applications using the Go programming language
Understand how the web works at a protocol and server level, per the book's stated purpose
Useful for developers switching to Go from PHP, Python, Ruby, or C/C++
The book is open source; text is licensed CC BY-SA 3.0 and code is BSD 3-Clause
summary.summary: This is the landing page for an open-source GitBook titled Build Web Application with Golang, written by its author in their spare time. The page states the book's purpose: to teach building web applications with Go, and to explain how the web works for readers from PHP, Python, Ruby, or C/C++ backgrounds. The visible page text also includes donation and community links, an acknowledgments list of reviewers, and license details. The excerpt shown does not include the chapter contents, so the specific topics covered are not listed here.
